call.text: Moshi’s theoretical latency of 160 ms is specified as a design goal of its streaming, hierarchical architecture in the introduction[MOSHI:1:c005] and is reinforced by the abstract’s statement of a 160 ms theoretical latency[MOSHI:abstract:c002]. The abstract also reports that Moshi achieves a practical latency of about 200 ms in operation[MOSHI:abstract:c002]. Natural conversations are reported to have an average response time of 230 ms across ten languages[MOSHI:1:c005]. Thus, Moshi’s practical latency of 200 ms is lower than the typical natural‑conversation latency of 230 ms.
